data.body: RCA: the freshness refusal is driven by _store.freshness._ref_divergence. That path proved a common ancestor, saw HEAD as an ancestor of the fetched remote ref, then trusted rev-list HEAD..origin/tickets --count without validating that the count was positive. Under a moving remote-tracking snapshot or inconsistent git probe, that can produce (behind, 0), which store_freshness then turns into a stale-store refusal whose own evidence says 0 commits behind. The sibling DIVERGED and push-pending messages are driven by distinct branches: DIVERGED requires merge-base/no-ancestor failure; push-pending requires the durable push_state pending marker and reports unpushed count, so this zero-count boundary bug is confined to the behind branch. Fix: treat behind<=0 as level/fresh, preserving fail-closed behavior for positive behind counts and divergence/push-pending.
